issues.explanation: The ledger excerpt says the cause is unrecorded, while the draft claim says the ledger blames Pell.

evidence.excerpt: The harbour crane collapsed at dawn; the harbour ledger leaves the cause of the collapse unrecorded.

issues.reasoning: The cited ledger excerpt leaves the cause unrecorded, which tensions with the claim's attributed cause. The current claim has no literal time anchor, so same-time overlap with the ledger record cannot be proven; the contradiction remains possible rather than confirmed.
